name: goal_update
description: change or remove one persisted goal in state/goals.json, or list the whole store with action=list

from.description: Only write when the goal currently holds this status.

workspace.description: Re-point the goal to this workspace (project) id; empty moves it to the default workspace.

running.description: Mark a goal loop in flight (true) or finished (false); the auto-resume hook reads this.

worktree.description: Boolean flag from the web UI, or the worktree branch a run was assigned.

task_add.description: Add a first-class task to this goal. text is required; visible_to is an array of instance ids (empty means public).

task_toggle.description: Mark a task done or not done.
